Growth Portfolio – Centum RE
Strategies for Value Monetization.

Centum Real Estate has revamped its
business model to enhance performance
around key value drivers.

• Increase sales velocity within our land bank • We pursue a sell-to-build model
• We pre-sell at least 30% of units and collect 10% of sales
• High margin business with low cost of sales price before construction with the balance sold during
construction
• Target to realize over Kes 10Bn over • The business will now focus development of
Centum 4.0 affordable houses within our master planned
precincts with an aim to grow to other locations
within East Africa
